senses.sense_definition: A type of open shoe made up of straps or bands holding a sole to the foot

examples.text: My <w>sandal</w> broke, so I had to walk home without it.

target_lang_translations.pl: Mój <w>sandał</w> się zepsuł, więc musiałam wrócić do domu bez niego.
target_lang_translations.de: Meine <w>Sandale</w> ist kaputtgegangen, also musste ich ohne sie nach Hause laufen.

examples.text: He walked along the beach and got some sand inside his <w>sandal</w>.

target_lang_translations.de: Er ging am Strand entlang und bekam etwas Sand in seine <w>Sandale</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Il s'est promené le long de la plage et a eu du sable dans sa <w>sandale</w>.
target_lang_translations.it: Ha camminato lungo la spiaggia e gli è entrata della sabbia nel <w>sandalo</w>.

target_lang_translations.tr: Sahil boyunca yürüdü ve <w>sandaletinin</w> içine biraz kum kaçtı.
target_lang_translations.es: Caminó por la playa y le entró algo de arena en la <w>sandalia</w>.

target_lang_translations.ja: 彼は浜辺を歩いていたら、履いていた<w>サンダル</w>の中に砂が入ってしまいました。
target_lang_translations.pt: Caminhou pela praia e entrou-lhe areia numa <w>sandália</w>.
